# Check — M0-a-03, the spatial index: closing check of the kernel's consolidation round R5 (lane check/M0-a-03-consolidate-close-1, 2026-10-13)

**Verdict: PASS.** This checker re-ran every failing line of the round (X-1, X-2, X-3 / X-4, §3.4, API frozen,
NO-SHIFT) against its oracle and found each one fixed. The evidence is this checker's own. No new finding is a blocker.
The round changes no behaviour:

* **Answers.** A seeded NO-SHIFT probe hashes 221 710 lines of `query` and `pointLocate` answers, stamps included. It
  covers the four fixtures, 24 random arenas and 200 × 40 fuzz batches with their rebuilt pairs and row states. The
  pre-round mirror, the post-round mirror and the tree all give sha256 `95e82975…`. The probe is sensitive: mutants
  K13 and C1-up make it throw a debug assertion.
* **Exports.** The barrel's 673 exported names and `index/index.ts`'s 74 are identical before and after, with their
  types (TypeScript checker census). The only new export anywhere in the owns is the file-level `faceArea2` of
  `index/items.ts`.
* **Thrown texts.** Eight thrown texts are byte-identical before and after (probe).
* **Old and new tests.** The pre-round `test/index/` (10 files, 66 tests) passes on the new sources. The new `query`
  and `grid` pins pass on the pre-round sources.
* **Mutants.** 20 of 22 targeted mutants are red, among them the plan's oracle mutants K12, K13, K14, A9 and A10 and
  the earlier K1 and A1. Of the two survivors, one is equivalent. The other also survives on the pre-round code
  (a pre-existing gap) and goes to the notes.

The gates were install, lint (probe-red ok), build, NEAR (23 files, 375 / 375, with the here bar), `equivalence.test.ts` at 1000 (25 / 25) and landed:verify. Every one exits 0. RELATED@1000 had one red: vitest's 5 s default timeout on M0-a-15's `io/roundtrip.test.ts`. That red is foreign: the test times out the same way on the pre-round sources and goes green on both sides with a longer timeout (N-c1-7). The refusal count is 0 before and 0 after. Five notes rows (N-c1-3 – N-c1-7) go to
`checks/M0-a-03-notes.md`.

Seat: closing checker, independent of the author. The lane log had no earlier line for this lane key, so the check
started fresh. The checker read choices row C-0345 early, beside C-0313, to test the `stamp` claim against the code. It read
the author's round-C1 notes section and CLEAN-ROOM row L-0484 only after its own probes and mutants had run. All three
are judged here rather than used as evidence.

Machine: `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz:4cpu:16gib` (J198 id matches), Node v24.12.0. The worker budget
was 1 (`tools/test_budget.py` printed 1; mutant budget 1). No timing was taken or gated on. No git command was run.

## Method

* **Before-images.** The flow-7 snapshot holds hashes, not contents. This checker fetched the 19 owned files at main's
  head `851fa920` through the GitHub contents API (`gh api`, raw media type; no git). Each one's sha256 equals the
  flow-7 snapshot's (`landed/snapshots/flow-7.json`). Eleven equal the tree. The other eight are the record's eight
  "changed" files: `src/index/{index,items,query,spatial}.ts` and `test/index/{grid.test,items.test,query.test,support}.ts`.
* **Mirrors** under `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-03/`, each a whole copy of `plat/` with its own `node_modules`:
  * `ma`, the tree as it stood at 01:31: for the mutants.
  * `mb`, `ma` with the eight pre-round files swapped in: for before-runs.
  * `mr`, the tree at 01:38: for RELATED.

  Each mutant and each swap was restored and `cmp`-checked against the tree.

## New findings (blocker rule)

None is a blocker. Every gate of the item exits 0. RELATED's one red is a foreign wall-clock timeout that repeats on
the pre-round sources (N-c1-7, below). No listed interface or test id is missing, no shortcut was added, and no answer is
wrong on an honest input. Nothing breaches the clean room or lies outside `plat/`. The notes rows are N-c1-3 – N-c1-7 in
`checks/M0-a-03-notes.md`:

* **N-c1-3.** The index's foreign-key text is pinned only as `/handed the key/`. Mutant N1, which re-spells the key
  name, survives, and it survives on the pre-round code too.
* **N-c1-4.** The stamp doc cites C-0313 (5) for the façade's side-table generation, but C-0317 is the row that gave
  the façade's side table the generation.
* **N-c1-5.** "One seeded generator" in `support.ts`: seven kernel test files still carry their own mulberry32 copies.
* **N-c1-6.** C-0345 / L-0484 collide with main's rows of the same ids. This is for the session; items.ts's two
  comments and the faceArea2 describe title cite C-0345.
* **N-c1-7.** RELATED's one red is vitest's 5 s default timeout on M0-a-15's `io/roundtrip.test.ts`. It repeats
  identically on the pre-round sources, is green on both sides with a longer timeout, and is foreign to this round.
